mission_06: Great work! You have designed an FPGA-based AI accelerator model with fixed-point arithmetic, DSP block parallelism, and power efficiency analysis. Your implementation shows how FPGAs achieve energy efficiency through: fixed-point quantization that reduces bit-width and eliminates floating-point overhead, DSP block parallelism that processes multiple output channels simultaneously, and customizable architecture that eliminates unnecessary hardware. The throughput-power-efficiency trade-off is central to FPGA design: more DSP blocks increase throughput but also power, while lower precision reduces both. FPGAs are ideal for edge AI deployment where power budgets are tight and workloads are well-defined, offering a middle ground between the flexibility of GPUs and the efficiency of ASICs.
